 // (00-ARCHITECTURE.md §5.6). Canonicalize MUST be idempotent:[m
 // Canonicalize(Canonicalize(x).Canonical, o) == Canonicalize(x, o).[m
 //[m
[31m-// This package declares the interface only: the twelve concrete canonicalizers §5.6 names (crlf,[m
[31m-// ansi, timestamps, durations, pids, addresses, tmpPaths, then per-tool bash, testrunner, grep,[m
[31m-// glob, fileread, webfetch, git) are SP-04's implementation, not SP-01's stub.[m
[32m+[m[32m// Idempotence is achieved structurally rather than by convention: every built-in replaces a span[m
[32m+[m[32m// with a token built from '<' and '>', characters that appear in no pattern, so no token can ever[m
[32m+[m[32m// match a rule on a second pass. A canonicalizer added later must uphold the same property.[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// Every built-in ALSO implements Matcher, which is what Registry.Run composes over; Canonicalize[m
[32m+[m[32m// is the standalone path, and each built-in implements it by delegating to the same sort/accept/[m
[32m+[m[32m// apply pass Run uses, so a canonicalizer behaves identically alone and inside the registry.[m
[32m+[m[32m// Result.Signature is left zero by a standalone Canonicalize: only Run sees the fully[m
[32m+[m[32m// canonicalized bytes, and a near-duplicate score for a partially canonicalized document would be[m
[32m+[m[32m// a score for something that never gets stored.[m

[32m+[m[32m// tmpPaths, plus per-tool passes for bash, testrunner, grep, glob, fileread, webfetch and git)[m
[32m+[m[32m// that strips volatile, low-signal content before chunking (Qompack.md §8.1, O2), together with[m
[32m+[m[32m// the MinHash signature computed over the canonicalized result and the byte-exact Restore inverse.[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// # Why this package exists[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// Exact-hash deduplication is defeated by volatile substrings. Timestamps, ANSI escape codes,[m
[32m+[m[32m// PIDs, memory addresses, temp-dir paths and run durations make every Bash and test-runner result[m
[32m+[m[32m// unique even when it is semantically identical to the last one, so a content-addressed store with[m
[32m+[m[32m// no canonicalization in front of it grows linearly in the number of test runs. Qompack.md §8.1:[m
[32m+[m[32m// "Test and build output is the noisiest content class in a coding session; this is where the[m
[32m+[m[32m// dedup ratio is won or lost." test/dedup measures that claim rather than asserting it.[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// # Composition is a single pass, not a chain[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// Registry.Run does not pipe the output of one canonicalizer into the next. Every canonicalizer[m
[32m+[m[32m// also implements Matcher and reports the spans it would rewrite in the ORIGINAL input; Run sorts[m
[32m+[m[32m// those spans once, resolves overlaps once, and rewrites once. Three properties fall out of that[m
[32m+[m[32m// choice rather than having to be maintained by fourteen separate implementations:[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m//   - Delta coordinates are unambiguous. In a chain, each stage shifts the previous stage's[m
[32m+[m[32m//     offsets, so a Delta means nothing without knowing how many stages ran after it.[m
[32m+[m[32m//   - Restore is order-independent. It replays an ascending, non-overlapping list in one forward[m
[32m+[m[32m//     pass and never needs to know which canonicalizer produced which span.[m
[32m+[m[32m//   - Non-growth and Options.Strip gating are structural. The accept loop drops any match whose[m
[32m+[m[32m//     token is longer than its span, and any match whose Class is not in play, in one place — so[m
[32m+[m[32m//     a canonicalizer cannot bypass a user's store.canonicalize.strip setting, and §5.6's "no[m
[32m+[m[32m//     canonicalizer ever grows its input" holds by construction.[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m

[32m+[m[32m// Run canonicalizes in as tool's output at path.[m

[32m+[m[32m// validateStrip rejects an Options.Strip naming a Class that is not one of KnownClasses.[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// This is a hard failure rather than a silent skip because a typo in store.canonicalize.strip[m
[32m+[m[32m// silently disables a canonicalizer, and the only symptom is a dedup ratio that is quietly worse[m
[32m+[m[32m// than it should be — a bug with no error message and a months-long feedback loop.[m
[32m+[m[32mfunc validateStrip(strip []Class) error {[m
[32m+[m	[32mfor _, c := range strip {[m
[32m+[m		[32mif _, ok := ParseClass(string(c)); !ok {[m
[32m+[m			[32mreturn fmt.Errorf("%w: %q (known: %s)", ErrUnknownClass, c, strings.Join(classNames(), ", "))[m
[32m+[m		[32m}[m
[32m+[m	[32m}[m
[32m+[m	[32mreturn nil[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m// classNames renders KnownClasses for an error message.[m
[32m+[m[32mfunc classNames() []string {[m

[32m+[m	[32m}[m
[32m+[m	[32mreturn out[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m

[32m+[m[32m// restoreHeadroom is the slack Restore preallocates beyond len(canonical). Every Delta replaces a[m
[32m+[m[32m// token with something at least as long, so the reconstruction is never shorter than the[m
[32m+[m[32m// canonical form; this is a first guess at the overshoot, not a bound.[m

 [m
 // Restore applies deltas to canonical to reconstruct the original, pre-canonicalization bytes: a[m
 // byte-exact inverse of Canonicalize when Options.KeepDeltas was set (00-ARCHITECTURE.md §5.6).[m
[31m-// Restore always reports core.ErrNotImplemented until SP-04 lands the real implementation.[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// It is a single forward pass, which is the whole reason Registry.Run composes matches over the[m
[32m+[m[32m// original input rather than chaining byte transforms: every Delta.Offset is in canonical[m
[32m+[m[32m// coordinates and the list is ascending and non-overlapping, so Restore never has to know which[m
[32m+[m[32m// canonicalizer produced which span, or in what order they ran.[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// Restore never panics on adversarial input — FuzzRestore asserts that over arbitrary byte slices[m
[32m+[m[32m// and arbitrary Delta lists. A malformed list is reported: ErrDeltaRange for an offset or length[m
[32m+[m[32m// outside canonical, ErrDeltaOrder for a non-monotonic list. Both wrap with %w so a caller can[m
[32m+[m[32m// errors.Is them; SP-06 treats either as a corrupt side record rather than as a missing object.[m
 func Restore(canonical []byte, deltas []Delta) ([]byte, error) {[m
[31m-	return nil, core.ErrNotImplemented[m
[32m+[m	[32mif len(deltas) == 0 {[m
[32m+[m		[32m// A copy, never the caller's backing array: Restore's result outlives the canonical buffer[m
[32m+[m		[32m// in SP-06's read path, where the canonical bytes come straight out of a pooled decompress[m
[32m+[m		[32m// buffer that is reused for the next object.[m
[32m+[m		[32mreturn append([]byte(nil), canonical...), nil[m
[32m+[m	[32m}[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mout := make([]byte, 0, len(canonical)+restoreHeadroom)[m
[32m+[m	[32mprev := 0[m
[32m+[m	[32mfor i, d := range deltas {[m
[32m+[m		[32mif i > 0 && d.Offset < deltas[i-1].Offset {[m
[32m+[m			[32mreturn nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: delta %d offset %d precedes delta %d offset %d",[m
[32m+[m				[32mErrDeltaOrder, i, d.Offset, i-1, deltas[i-1].Offset)[m
[32m+[m		[32m}[m
[32m+[m		[32mif d.Offset < prev || d.Len < 0 || d.Offset < 0 || d.Offset+d.Len > len(canonical) {[m
[32m+[m			[32mreturn nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: delta %d offset=%d len=%d canonical=%d",[m
[32m+[m				[32mErrDeltaRange, i, d.Offset, d.Len, len(canonical))[m
[32m+[m		[32m}[m
[32m+[m		[32mout = append(out, canonical[prev:d.Offset]...)[m
[32m+[m		[32mout = append(out, d.Original...)[m
[32m+[m		[32mprev = d.Offset + d.Len[m
[32m+[m	[32m}[m
[32m+[m	[32mreturn append(out, canonical[prev:]...), nil[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m// LineEndingClass reports the original line-ending class of a canonicalized payload: "lf", "crlf"[m
[32m+[m[32m// or "mixed". canonicalNewlines is bytes.Count(canonical, "\n").[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// 00-ARCHITECTURE.md §4 requires the original line-ending class to be recorded as a canon.Delta,[m
[32m+[m[32m// which the crlf canonicalizer does. This function is how a caller reads it back without a second[m
[32m+[m[32m// scan over the payload, and without SP-04 adding a field to the §5.6 Result struct (which it may[m
[32m+[m[32m// not do — that would need an arch amendment).[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// It counts only Deltas whose Class is ClassCRLF AND whose Original is exactly "\r\n". ClassCRLF[m
[32m+[m[32m// also carries the always-on trailing-whitespace rule that bash, grep, glob and fileread share —[m
[32m+[m[32m// trailing whitespace is line-terminator normalization by the same argument as CRLF→LF — and[m
[32m+[m[32m// counting those as line endings would report "mixed" for a pure-LF file that merely had a few[m
[32m+[m[32m// trailing spaces.[m
[32m+[m[32mfunc LineEndingClass(deltas []Delta, canonicalNewlines int) string {[m
[32m+[m	[32mcrlfCount := 0[m
[32m+[m	[32mfor _, d := range deltas {[m
[32m+[m		[32mif d.Class == ClassCRLF && d.Original == "\r\n" {[m
[32m+[m			[32mcrlfCount++[m
[32m+[m		[32m}[m
[32m+[m	[32m}[m
[32m+[m	[32mswitch {[m
[32m+[m	[32mcase crlfCount == 0:[m
[32m+[m		[32mreturn "lf"[m
[32m+[m	[32mcase crlfCount == canonicalNewlines:[m
[32m+[m		[32mreturn "crlf"[m
[32m+[m	[32mdefault:[m
[32m+[m		[32mreturn "mixed"[m
[32m+[m	[32m}[m
 }[m

[32m+[m[32m// TestResultSet_MatchesFrozenGolden pins the on-disk shape of state/contract.json's results array.[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// §16 lists the contract result set among the format fixtures that are authorable and frozen at[m
[32m+[m[32m// SP-01, and it had no fixture: the manifest declared only a behaviour fixture deferred to SP-05.[m
[32m+[m[32m// That left the one artifact two other subsystems read — /qompack:status renders it, and the next[m
[32m+[m[32m// SessionStart loads it — with no frozen shape at all, so any wave could have respelled a JSON tag[m
[32m+[m[32m// without anything noticing.[m
[32m+[m[32m//[m
[32m+[m[32m// The assertion is byte-level against the committed golden rather than field-by-field, because the[m
[32m+[m[32m// bytes are the interface here. A field renamed, dropped, or newly emitted all change them, and all[m
[32m+[m[32m// three are breaking changes to a file other components parse.[m
[32m+[m[32mfunc TestResultSet_MatchesFrozenGolden(t *testing.T) {[m
[32m+[m	[32mt.Parallel()[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mm := contract.NewMonitor(logging.Nop(), obs.New(resultSetClock), filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "contract.json"))[m
[32m+[m	[32mfor _, a := range contract.StandardAssertions() {[m
[32m+[m		[32mrequire.NoError(t, m.Register(a))[m
[32m+[m	[32m}[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mresults, mode := m.RunAll(context.Background(), contract.Env{Clock: resultSetClock})[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32m// §12.1: a build whose producers are all absent is ModeFull, never degraded. If this ever[m
[32m+[m	[32m// flips, the golden below is the least of the problems — every wave-1 and wave-2 verification[m
[32m+[m	[32m// run would be silently disabling the paths it is meant to be testing.[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.Equal(t, contract.ModeFull, mode,[m
[32m+[m		[32m"a fresh build reports every assertion OK/SevInfo, so the monitor must stay in full mode")[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.Len(t, results, 9, "§5.19 fixes the assertion set at nine")[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mgot, err := json.MarshalIndent(results, "", "  ")[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.NoError(t, err)[m
[32m+[m	[32mgot = append(got, '\n')[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mwant, err := os.ReadFile(resultSetGolden)[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.NoError(t, err, "the frozen result-set fixture is missing")[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.Equal(t, string(want), string(got),[m
[32m+[m		[32m"the contract result set drifted from its frozen §16 fixture.\n"+[m
[32m+[m			[32m"state/contract.json is read by /qompack:status and by the next SessionStart, so this "+[m
[32m+[m			[32m"is a wire-format change, not a formatting one. Rule W-2 applies: a fixture the "+[m
[32m+[m			[32m"implementation cannot reproduce is a verification failure, not a fixture bug.")[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m// TestResultSet_GoldenRoundTripsLosslessly is the other half of Rule W-2: the frozen bytes must be[m
[32m+[m[32m// consumable by the declared type, not merely producible by it. A field on disk that []Result does[m
[32m+[m[32m// not model would be dropped here in silence, and the golden would become unreproducible by the[m
[32m+[m[32m// first implementation that tried.[m
[32m+[m[32mfunc TestResultSet_GoldenRoundTripsLosslessly(t *testing.T) {[m
[32m+[m	[32mt.Parallel()[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mraw, err := os.ReadFile(resultSetGolden)[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.NoError(t, err)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mvar results []contract.Result[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &results))[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.Len(t, results, 9)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mround, err := json.MarshalIndent(results, "", "  ")[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.NoError(t, err)[m
[32m+[m	[32mrequire.Equal(t, string(raw), string(round)+"\n")[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m	[32mfor _, r := range results {[m
[32m+[m		[32mrequire.True(t, r.OK, "%s: a fresh build reports every assertion OK", r.ID)[m
[32m+[m		[32mrequire.Equal(t, contract.SevInfo, r.Severity,[m
[32m+[m			[32m"%s: the OBSERVED severity is SevInfo even where the assertion DECLARES SevCritical", r.ID)[m
[32m+[m		[32mrequire.NotEmpty(t, r.Expected, "%s: Expected is half the degraded banner", r.ID)[m
[32m+[m		[32mrequire.NotEmpty(t, r.Observed, "%s: Observed is the other half", r.ID)[m
[32m+[m		[32mrequire.Positive(t, int64(r.TS), "%s: an untimestamped result cannot be aged out", r.ID)[m
[32m+[m	[32m}[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m
